Staycity Aparthotels, Dublin Castle
Ireland
Wildflower parks, arcade shopping, church bells, castles*, Victorian pubs, religious paraphernalia, theatres, and Georgian architecture.
Stay in Dublin’s buzzy, bustling centre in our stylish aparthotel. Right beside the historic Dublin Castle, just moments from St Patrick’s Cathedral and a short walk from the Royal Convention Centre, you’ll be perfectly placed whether you're exploring the city or travelling for business. With Temple Bar, Trinity College, and the Guinness Storehouse just a hop, skip, and a pint away, you’d be hard pressed to find a more convenient location to discover Dublin. Plus, the city's main shopping streets and business districts are all within easy walking distance.
*Dublin got its name from Black Pool (Dubh Linn), a deep dark pool located in Dublin Castle.

FAQs
What is an aparthotel?
Expect the perfect blend of home and hotel from a Staycity aparthotel. This means you have all the freedom, privacy and creature comforts of your own home through the likes of a fully equipped kitchen and spacious dining, living and working spaces, combined with the consistency and convenience of standard hotel services such as 24-hour reception, fresh towels and bed linen, and cleaning.
Is the aparthotel centrally located?
Absolutely. Whether you’re here for work, play or a little of both, you’re right in the heart of the action. Set among old Dublin’s redbrick streets, turrets and towers, the area has the feel of a modern fairy tale.
You’re within walking distance of Trinity College (1km), Temple Bar (0.3km), Dublin Castle (0.2km) and St Patrick’s Cathedral (0.2km), with the Royal Convention Centre just a two-minute walk away, 3Olympia Theatre five minutes away and Vicar Street a ten-minute stroll.
Do you provide room cleaning?
Your apartment is yours to enjoy, with all the space and freedom of having your own place in the city. For stays of 1–6 nights, we don't provide a scheduled clean, but you'll have cleaning supplies and fresh towels in your apartment, and you can arrange an additional clean with reception for a small fee. Staying 7 nights or more? We'll give your apartment a full clean on day 4, and every 7 days after that. Need extra towels or supplies? Just ask our reception team – we're always happy to help.
Do you have parking?
We don’t have an on-site carpark. However, the closest car park is Qpark Christchurch just a 2 minute walk from the Aparthotel. Book online at  q-park.ie.
Do you serve food and drinks?
Yes! Our Staycafé is open 24/7 and serves morning pastries, snacks and pizzas throughout the day (you can order these to go and enjoy them in your apartment), freshly ground coffee and a wide range of drinks including soft drinks, beer and wine.
Don’t forget you’re also free to rustle up your own breakfast in your fully equipped kitchen, or order in! Just ask one of our friendly team for insider information on where you can pick up all the best ingredients.
How do I get there from the airport?
You can book transport to/from the airport with our bus partner, Dublin Express . With departures every 10 mins at peak times, the journey time is just 35 minutes. The Wellington Quay stop is a 9 min walk from our Dublin Castle Aparthotel.
Do you provide cots and high chairs?
Yes, we provide complimentary cots and high chairs. A fitted sheet is included with the travel cot, but you need to provide the rest. You can add cots and high chairs to your booking on staycity.com so they're in your apartment when you arrive.
Do you offer discounts for longer stays?
Yes! We offer 20% off stays for 7 - 21 nights and 30% off stays for over 21 nights.
Can I bring my e-bike or e-scooter into the hotel?
No. Due to the fire hazard associated with lithium-ion batteries, e-bikes, e-scooters and their associated lithium-ion batteries are not permitted in any area of the hotel. This includes guest rooms, corridors, car parks and back-of-house areas. This policy applies to all guests, contractors and delivery riders.

Good to Know
Cleaning
As an aparthotel, we want you to enjoy all the freedom, space and flexibility of having your own place to stay. Your apartment is your space to live, relax and settle in, so we leave you to enjoy it your way. We don’t provide daily housekeeping, but you’ll find everything you need to keep things fresh and tidy throughout your stay.
Staying 1–6 nights?
There’s no scheduled clean during your stay. Cleaning supplies, bin bags and fresh towels are provided in your apartment, so you can keep things just the way you like them. If you'd like a full refresh, including fresh linen and towels, our reception team can arrange an additional clean for a small charge.
Staying 7 nights or more?
We’ll carry out a full clean of your apartment on day 4 of your stay, including fresh bed linen and towels, and every 7 days after that.

Long Stays at Staycity
Extend Your Stay
Save up to 30%
7+ nights - Save 20%
21+ nights - Save 30%
Relocating? Away on business? Just need a bit of space? Whatever the reason you need a longer stay, we’ve got you covered.
Our aparthotels have everything you need to settle in and feel at home. Our 24hr receptions are always there if you have any questions. Want to rustle up your favourite meal? Our fully equipped kitchens have everything you’ll need. Need to keep up with your workouts? Our fitness rooms are ready when you are. Grab a bite at our Staycafés, pick up essentials from our in-house pantries, and keep things fresh with our laundry facilities.
Stay a little longer and unlock bigger savings. Enjoy 20% off when you stay 7+ nights , while 21+ nights means 30% off . However long you stay, we’ll make sure you’re well looked after.
*Subject to availability and exclusions may apply
Long Stays Made Easy
Our Apartments
Whether you re with us for weekly or monthly stays, our spacious apartments have everything you need to make yourself at home. Each comes with a fully-equipped kitchen, so you can whip up meals and snacks whenever you like - no need to live on takeaways or always eat on the go. Many apartments offer dedicated workspaces - perfect for getting things done when you need to and unwinding when you don t. Our smart TVs mean you ll never miss your favourite shows, plus you can even stream your playlists while you cook, work, or put your feet up.
Extended Stays Your Way
Our Amenities
Our amenities make longer stays feel effortless. Keep your fitness routine on track in our exercise rooms and take advantage of our on-site laundry facilities so you can pack light and always feel fresh. Our 24-hour reception teams are there whenever you need them - whether it s for an extra pillow, a restaurant recommendation, or just a friendly chat. Many of our aparthotels have Staycaf s, serving delicious breakfasts, pizzas, and tasty snacks. You ll also find handy pantries stocked with everyday essentials and ingredients, so you can rustle up meals or snacks in your kitchen whenever you like.
FAQs
Is an upfront payment needed for my long stay?
You will need to pay a 20% non-refundable deposit when you make the reservation. The remaining balance may be paid in advance via our online check-in process, or with a team member upon arrival on the day of check-in.
Do I need to pay a deposit for a long stay?
You will need to pay a 20% non-refundable deposit when you make a reservation for a longer stay.
Are bills included in my stay?
Your stay is inclusive of accommodation, VAT and complimentary weekly cleans, and of course standard bills such as electricity, gas, Wi-Fi and water are covered. Any additional packages are subject to additional charges. These can be added on our website, calling our Reservations team pre-arrival, or asking a member of our Reception team upon check-in.
Is there a maximum length of stay threshold?
To avail of our long stay discount, guests can book stays online of up to 28 days. For stays of over 28 days, guests can book through our Reservations and Sales team . We are happy to accommodate stays of several months.
Can I have guests over?
Non-paying guests are permitted to visit the premises during the stay. However, for overnight stays, only guests that have been added to the existing reservation can stay in the apartment. The occupancy level of the apartment is not to be exceeded, and must adhere to our Health and Safety regulations.
Can I bring my dog?
Yes, you are welcome to bring your dog for any stays over seven nights. Simply call our Reservations team after making your booking to add the package. Our team will be happy to help, subject to availability. The cost for bringing your dog is £15/€15 per night for stays of 7–28 -28 nights, and £5/€5 per night for stays of 29 nights or more. There is also a once-off deep clean fee of £50/€50. You can read all the details of our Pet Policy .

New Openings And Locations
Our New Locations
Feel Like a Local in London
Deptford Bridge,
London
Live music, independent markets, riverside walks, creative spaces, local pubs and plenty of South East London character. Set in the heart of Deptford, our aparthotel puts you close to one of London s most vibrant neighbourhoods, with Deptford Bridge DLR just moments away. Browse the independent stalls and local businesses at Deptford Market Yard, tucked beneath restored Victorian railway arches, discover caf s, galleries and breweries in reimagined dockyard spaces, or wander over to Greenwich for leafy parks and riverside views. With Canary Wharf and central London within easy reach, it s an ideal base for experiencing a more local side of the capital.
Book Now
Check out exciting new offers
Travel inspiration: London's Greenwich: Top 8 Attractions for UK Staycations
France s Food Capital
Lyon,
Rue Garibaldi
Charming streets, riverside strolls, celebrated gastronomy, impressive landmarks and the unmistakable charm of one of France s great cities. Set on Rue Garibaldi, our aparthotel puts you between the lively Part-Dieu district and the banks of the Rh ne, with some of Lyon s best-known sights within easy reach. Browse the stalls at Les Halles de Lyon Paul Bocuse, wander towards the grand Place Bellecour, or cross the river to explore the cobbled streets and hidden traboules of Vieux Lyon. Head up to the magnificent Basilica of Notre-Dame de Fourvi re for panoramic views across the city, or simply settle into a neighbourhood caf and experience Lyon at your own pace.
Book Now

Travel inspiration: Lyon is for Foodies
City Centre Location
Dresden,
City Centre
Baroque architecture, Elbe riverside views, classical music, world-class museums, Dresden Zwinger, vast city parks, Saxon cuisine and magnificent palaces. Nestled in the heart of the Old Town, our aparthotel offers a front-row seat to the city s beauty, just steps from the iconic Zwinger Palace. Stroll through the neighborhood s winding cobbled streets, discover hidden caf s, and explore boutique shops.

City Centre Location
Leipzig,
City Centre
Classical music, creative vibes, hidden arcades, Leipzig Zoo, cobbled streets, historic concert halls, contemporary art, St Thomas Church, and a buzzing nightlife. Located on Augustusplatz, our aparthotel puts you at the center of Leipzig s vibrant cultural scene. Just moments from landmarks like the Gewandhaus concert hall and Thomaskirche, it s an ideal spot for those who appreciate the city s rich musical and architectural heritage.
